entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One mouse, S<NN> at the end of the file names. The data descriptor does not name this part of the file name; its file list omits it. The reading as a mouse number is inferred: each of the four groups has 3 or 4 values, and the descriptor says 'Cells from each sub-group were recorded from at least 3 independent mice'.

entityTypes.name: recording
entityTypes.description: One ABF file from a CA1 pyramidal neuron: current steps of 50 to 400 pA in 50 pA increments, 400 ms, from -65 mV.

genotype.name: genotype
genotype.title: Genotype
genotype.description: APPPS1 or control (wild-type littermate), from the group folder name.

age_group.name: age_group
age_group.title: Age group
age_group.description: 3-4 months (presymptomatic) or 9-10 months (symptomatic), from the group folder name.

recording_date.name: recording_date
recording_date.title: Recording date
recording_date.description: The first six digits of the file name. The data descriptor: 'The digits represent the date when the data was recorded'.

experimenter.name: experimenter
experimenter.title: Experimenter
experimenter.description: The data descriptor: 'the _rita specifies the author that recorded the trace. All other traces were recorded by Hélène MARIE.' Files without _rita take the default.

dataLocations.description: Salgueiro-Pereira and Marie, excitability profile of CA1 pyramidal neurons in APP-PS1 Alzheimer disease mice and control littermates (dataset version bd5f91ff-e829-4b85-92eb-fc56991541f1). One folder per group, <APPPS1_mouse_model|control>_<3-4|9-10>_months, holding the ABF files <yyMMdd><NNN>[_rita]_S<NN>.abf; the data descriptor and the licence at the root. The descriptor lists the files without the _S<NN> part. Every entry of the bucket was listed.
